svg.text: CHARACTER TURNAROUND · v5 · matches nano-banana canon: open vest, horizontal daishō, fanged grin
the only view that becomes a sprite

g.text: The mask is worn, not grown. Under it
is a man, and the game should show him:
· at Snapshot shrines, resting, mask off
· on the title screen, mask in hand
· final boss phase 3 — it wears his face
Deep brown skin, short natural hair,
Skin now shows in gameplay too: sleeves
are pushed to the elbow, so bare forearms
and hands read on every sprite.
SotN rule: the haori is Alucard's cape —
broad, and it does half the acting.

svg.text: — horns, ponytail, ragged hem, sheathed daishō. Four reads, no face needed.
Alucard-height. Cloth and hair carry the
motion: haori + ponytail are half the mass.
Mask + white haori remain the two anchors.
12 → 15. Three skin tones added; a warm ramp in a cold palette, so it reads as
living against all that neon. Use a CYAN rim light on skin to tie it back in.
#5E3620 is a mid-shadow mixed from the ramp, not a 16th color.
Original design derived from the Cyb3r$h1n1g4m1 persona motifs — mask, horns, hair, 死神. Not a reproduction of the HACKERverse/KIKRR logo artwork.
